notes.title: Patch 1.2 is NOW LIVE!!!
notes.notes:
- Added 6 new unique rooms for you to explore and learn!
- Increased the Size of Bosses to make them more Noticeable
- Added indicators on the walls to show what you must do to avoid a boss
